Name: Rainy Day Clothing
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
Adds a yellow raincoat and matching gumboots for your farmer to wear on rainy days! You'll get a letter from Pierre on the Spring 2, advertising that he'll be stocking clothes for the rainy day forecast for Spring 3. After that, he'll sell replacement gear on every rainy day.

As [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/649]Longevity[/url] is going to end-of-life support, the compatibility with my mod won't be automatically updated - please send me a message if you require help!

Downloads.Description: Rainy day clothing for Content Patcher, compatible with Longevity's MCM element.
